description: This Python script fetches discussions and comments from a GitHub repository using GraphQL, processes contributor data to identify experts and maintainers, updates a YAML data file with this information, and creates a pull request with the update.

classes.name: Author
classes.description: Represents a GitHub user with login, avatar URL, and profile URL.

classes.name: CommentsNode
classes.description: Represents a comment with creation time and author information.

classes.name: Replies
classes.description: Contains total count and list of reply comment nodes.

classes.name: DiscussionsCommentsNode
classes.description: A comment node within a discussion, including replies.

classes.name: DiscussionsNode
classes.description: Represents a discussion thread with metadata and comments.

classes.name: DiscussionsEdge
classes.description: Edge in the discussions GraphQL response containing a cursor and discussion node.

classes.name: Discussions
classes.description: Contains a list of discussion edges.

classes.name: DiscussionsRepository
classes.description: Wrapper for discussions in a repository.

classes.name: DiscussionsResponseData
classes.description: Data model for the discussions API response.

classes.name: DiscussionsResponse
classes.description: Top-level response model wrapping the data field.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Configuration settings for GitHub token, repository, and timeout parameters.

classes.name: DiscussionExpertsResults
classes.description: Aggregated results of discussion comment analysis, including counters and author details.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] get_graphql_response( *, settings: Settings, query: str, after: Union[str, None] = None, category_id: Union[str, None] = None, )
methods.description: Sends a GraphQL request to GitHub API and returns the response data after error validation.

methods.name: list[DiscussionsEdge] get_graphql_question_discussion_edges( *, settings: Settings, after: Union[str, None] = None, )
methods.description: Fetches discussion edges for questions from GitHub GraphQL API.

methods.name: list[DiscussionsNode] get_discussion_nodes(settings: Settings)
methods.description: Retrieves all discussion nodes by paginating through discussion edges.

methods.name: DiscussionExpertsResults get_discussions_experts( discussion_nodes: list[DiscussionsNode], )
methods.description: Analyzes discussion nodes to identify commenters and their activity over different timeframes.

methods.name: list[dict[str,Any]] get_top_users( *, counter: Counter[str], authors: dict[str, Author], skip_users: Container[str], min_count: int = 2, )
methods.description: Filters and returns a list of top commenters with minimum count criteria.

methods.name: list[dict[str,Any]] get_users_to_write( *, counter: Counter[str], authors: dict[str, Author], min_count: int = 2, )
methods.description: Prepares a list of users who meet minimum comment count for updating data.

methods.name: bool update_content(*, content_path: Path, new_content: Any)
methods.description: Reads a file, compares it with new content, and writes updates if changes are detected.

methods.name: None main()
methods.description: Main execution function that orchestrates fetching discussions, analyzing data, updating YAML, and creating a pull request.
